title: Windows host: sync/team test cluster fails on a stock setup
observation:
RESOLVED 2026-08-18 on the exact evidence this finding demanded: a FRESH CLEAN CLONE (github.com/davesheffer/hunch @ 5671523, which includes 3cb75af's LF canonicalization) ran the full `npm test` (--test-concurrency=2) on this Windows host: 1100 tests, 1092 pass, 0 fail, 7 skipped. The deterministic sync/team cluster this finding tracked did NOT reproduce. The run's single non-pass was one 60s spawn timeout in test/team-route-contract.test.ts ('a CLI command refuses all handlers when its route changes during the startup pull') — that is the separately-catalogued load-starvation flake fnd_503db3a619 (accepted-risk: passes solo, times out only under full-suite parallel load on a slow host), not this cluster.

HISTORY, kept for lineage: the 2026-08-11 claim that it reproduces in the working repo did not hold on 2026-08-12 (working-repo run green: 1080/1073/0). Mechanism confirmed by the clean-clone run: the host carried an uncommitted local core.autocrlf=false while the system value was true, and .gitattributes had no text directive — the working repo and a fresh clone did not see the same bytes until 3cb75af made LF canonical (`* text=auto eol=lf` + renormalize of 13 CRLF-committed files).
